# Bob-core material laboratory and alloy-output witness

This private F210 2.1.23 fixture is for the exact no-Angel Bob-core closure captured in `tests/fixtures/bob-core-f210-captured-facts.json`. Before it accelerates anything, its data-final stage checks the independent identities, ordered prerequisites, ordered science vectors, default cost and time, finite/tail boundary, presentation flags, and recipe-productivity effect for all fourteen selected technologies: Tin, Lead, Bronze, Gunmetal, Invar, Nitinol and Copper Tungsten.

It additionally checks five finite, applicable upstream physical routes before adding fixture-owned fast machine clones:

| Route | Native owner | Inputs | Output | F210 category / time |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bob-bronze-alloy` | `bob-alloy-processing` | 3 copper plate, 2 tin plate | 5 bronze alloy | `bob-mixing-furnace`, 16 s |
| `bob-gunmetal-alloy` | `bob-zinc-processing` | 8 copper plate, 1 tin plate, 1 zinc plate | 10 gunmetal alloy | `bob-mixing-furnace`, 32 s |
| `bob-invar-alloy` | `bob-invar-processing` | 2 nickel plate, 3 iron plate | 5 invar alloy | `bob-mixing-furnace`, 16 s |
| `bob-nitinol-alloy` | `bob-nitinol-processing` | 3 nickel plate, 2 titanium plate | 5 nitinol alloy | `bob-mixing-furnace`, 16 s |
| `bob-copper-tungsten-alloy` | `bob-tungsten-processing` | 3 powdered tungsten, 20 molten copper | 5 copper-tungsten alloy | `metallurgy`, 16 s |

The archive source is exact `bobplates_3.0.2.zip`, SHA-256 `0C9A4910E2DCAA8DCABBE5BFFA67333F214EAB2EFD8C798D5EF84D90B691862D`, member `bobplates/prototypes/recipe/alloy-recipe.lua`, SHA-256 `F5AC531FE73DFD2D05EFCCF453F17BDFDC34B5B5D5A92D4A23FC03EB9A3D6140`. Its static Invar and Nitinol rows provide the item/mixing routes. Its Space Age branch converts Copper Tungsten from the static copper-plate/mixing row to the captured F210 molten-copper/metallurgy row; `boblibrary`'s item-to-fluid conversion makes the two copper plates 20 molten copper. The fixture refuses any route, owner, product stochastic field, category, source machine, fluid-box, or inherent-productivity drift before it changes a MIR unit or extends either disposable machine clone.

The four mixing routes use a module-free clone of `bob-electric-mixing-furnace`. Copper Tungsten uses a separate module-free clone of the native Space Age `foundry`: its `metallurgy` category, four 1,000/1,000/100/100 fluid boxes and inherent `effect_receiver.base_effect.productivity=0.5` remain intact. The clone removes placement and upgrades and changes only crafting speed and module slots; it does not patch an upstream recipe, force recipe bonus, ordinary material tuning, or fluid capacity. Copper Tungsten's 2,000 molten-copper witness input is supplied in bounded native-capacity increments with `insert_fluid` and read back with the supported fluid APIs.

On a new disposable world the fixture seeds only the explicit non-MIR prerequisites. It first performs 100 real crafts of every selected alloy while the MIR recipe bonus is zero, then inserts the six independently named science packs into a real lab and earns three finite levels plus one continuation level for every family. Finally it performs 100 real crafts of every same untouched native route with the earned native 8% recipe productivity. Bronze, Invar and Nitinol require 500 before and 535–540 after; Gunmetal requires 1,000 before and 1,070–1,080 after; Copper Tungsten requires 750 before from the foundry's preserved 50% inherent productivity and 785–790 after. The latter must gain exactly seven or eight whole crafts from MIR while retaining its separate inherent baseline and a bounded productivity remainder.

The research phase requires 28 native `on_research_finished` events, exact 28/20/16/8/10/4 input consumption (automation/logistic/chemical/production/space/metallurgic), and a native 8% bonus on every named material route. The completed archive is `mir5-native-complete.zip`, as required by `Invoke-NativeFixture.ps1`; the native runner must then perform two cold reloads, where this fixture only reads the saved witness, including all five clean machine/input/output/fluid states.

The host control exercises data-stage rejection, every bounded pre-research physical input/output route, foundry fluid-capacity replenishment, and read-only save validation using small Lua doubles. It does not launch Factorio, establish a native physical result, or qualify ordinary recipe tuning, arbitrary Bob configurations, foreign-force behavior, migration, performance, multiplayer, final package, or release. The current candidate needs a new native production stage and two actual cold reloads for this five-route witness; the earlier Bob-core gameplay chain remains evidence only for its original 28-lab/save scope.
